title: kitab — a config-driven book-publishing template
description: A reusable, config-driven static book template extracted from the tabdili reader architecture. Presentation, content, and data are decoupled; a new book is config plus content. Multi-format readers (paginated, continuous scroll, liquid), self-describing 'talking artifact' figures with pop-out explanations, TTS and BYOK AI-explain, learning-to-doing links, and pure-GitHub-Pages visitor participation.
